card.name: Words just before AV block
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation right before the term "AV block" or "heart block", such as "degree", "existing", "(AV)" or "grade". It appears in cardiac conduction warnings.

modes.label: Degree words before block
modes.description: The word "degree" or "grade" right before AV block, as in second-degree or high-degree.
modes.example: conduction system abnormalities (e.g., junctional rhythm with AV dissociation and high<< degree>> AV block, including asystole).

modes.label: Closing bracket of (AV)
modes.description: The closing parenthesis after the abbreviation AV, just before the word block.

modes.label: Other lead-in words
modes.description: Linking words or word parts that lead into a heart block phrase, such as "pre-existing" or "of".
modes.example: in patients with pre<<-existing>> incomplete AV block.
